question: What is Argentina's current legal and operating perimeter for virtual-asset services, stablecoins and tokenised securities; which institutions and payment rails may participate; and where do title, final money, correction and loss remain?
bluf: Argentina has an operating CNV provider regime, fully applicable to the existing registered cohort since 31 December 2025, with five activity categories, minimum capital, custody, segregation, public proof-of-reserve, audit, conduct and reporting duties. CNV Resolution 1165, published on 7 September 2026, adds a compatibility matrix across agents, crowdfunding platforms, PSAVs, markets and clearinghouses without changing the requirements or limitations of each category. This is not a general approval of crypto as money: legal tender and fiat are outside the virtual-asset definition, and the BCRA still says regulated banks may not participate directly or indirectly in offering crypto to customers while payment-account providers may not facilitate unregulated and BCRA-unauthorized digital assets. That barrier explains the major-bank evidence: Galicia's April 2022 crypto launch was superseded by the May 2022 restriction; Banco Nacion says it is building capability for when the framework permits; Santander's Agrotoken lending work reached a pilot but not a verified current launch; and no live direct crypto product was located at BBVA Argentina or Banco Macro. Global-parent products cannot be attributed to the Argentine subsidiaries. The CNV tokenised-securities sandbox remains separate and keeps the authorized traditional security and depositary/holder-of-record chain behind its digital representation. MEP and Transferencias 3.0 are production fiat rails; no current official CBDC issuance or live pilot was located.

authority.summary: Congress and the Presidency enacted Law 27,739; CNV registers, regulates, supervises and sanctions PSAVs and applies securities law to tokenised securities; BCRA regulates banks, payment-account providers, FX and payment systems and operates MEP; UIF applies AML/CFT/FP; ARCA owns tax information; courts and security forces own investigation, seizure and adjudication.
authority.boundary: Statute, provider registration, bank/payment regulation, FX access, AML reporting, tax reporting, settlement operation, seizure and adjudication are different legal capacities.

legal_objects.summary: The record separates virtual assets, five PSAV service categories, private stablecoin claims, customer assets held in custody, fiat bank/payment-account balances, tokenised securities and their traditional deposited counterparts, and central-bank settlement balances. Legal tender and fiat currency are excluded from the virtual-asset definition.
legal_objects.boundary: A digital label or common platform does not merge issuer liability, customer title, custody, the traditional security, the holder of record, the depositary position or final-money entry.

permitted_activities.summary: CNV Categories 1-5 cover fiat-to-virtual-asset exchange, virtual-asset exchange, transfer, custody/control and specified issuer-offer/sale services. Natural persons may perform only Categories 1 and 2. Mere issuance, self-trading, ordinary merchant receipt, qualifying decentralized protocols without an identifiable provider and self-custody-only wallets are outside the cited PSAV definition; securities and BCRA-regulated activities retain their own perimeters.
permitted_activities.boundary: An exclusion from PSAV registration is not a general exemption from securities, consumer, tax, criminal, FX or other law.

entry_gates.summary: Covered providers must register before operating and identify the exact categories. Foreign providers face local-structure and nexus tests. Minimum net worth is US$150,000 for Categories 1, 2 and 4, US$75,000 for Category 3 and US$35,000 for Category 5, with a specified 50% reduction below US$2.5 million rolling transaction/custody thresholds. AML registration, governance, custody, systems, audit and reporting requirements apply separately.
entry_gates.boundary: Registration, exact category, BCRA permission, foreign nexus, AML status, technical operation and current compliance are separate gates.

named_operating_actors.summary: CNV publishes a JavaScript-backed PSAV register and accepts registrations/cancellations through TAD. The reviewed static surface did not yield a reliable cutoff export of exact legal persons, categories, suspensions and cancellations; a crawler's zero result is not treated as the cohort count. The BCRA's current entity list and major-private-bank group supply the bank perimeter, while its present crypto page retains the operating restriction. Banco Nacion, Galicia, Santander Argentina, BBVA Argentina and Banco Macro were reviewed as the major-bank layer. Galicia's own 2022 disclosure records a short-lived purchase, sale and custody launch before the BCRA restriction; Banco Nacion's 25 September 2026 statement describes capability-building pending permission; Santander's Agrotoken work reached a pilot; no current direct crypto trading, custody, deposit token or bank-issued stablecoin was verified at those five institutions.
named_operating_actors.boundary: Brand, foreign parent, local company, registered category, bank or payment participant, historical launch, pilot, capability build and current operating service are not interchangeable.

claims_and_backing.summary: Category 4 PSAVs must publish proof of reserves, separate customer virtual assets and fiat from own property, keep customer virtual assets outside PSAV assets and refrain from own-account use. No reviewed official source created a dedicated stablecoin issuer reserve, direct par-redemption, recognized-token or sovereign-guarantee regime. In the tokenised-securities sandbox, the traditional authorized security and its ADCVN deposit remain behind the digital representation.
claims_and_backing.boundary: Custodian asset coverage, stablecoin issuer reserves, holder redemption, security ownership, deposit insurance and state guarantee are distinct claims.

domestic_rails.summary: MEP is BCRA's production high-value electronic payment system; accepted transfers that pass validation and funds checks are irrevocable. Transferencias 3.0 supplies production 24/7 immediate retail transfers and interoperable QR payments over CBU/CVU accounts. PSAV books and blockchains are separate execution/custody records. Tokenised securities must remain synchronized with the conventional deposited security.
domestic_rails.boundary: Central-bank settlement, instant account credit, PSAV execution, blockchain confirmation, customer title and securities registration are different records.

cross_border_routes.summary: PSAV fiat exchange and transfer categories, estimated stablecoin use and Argentina's FX context show that cross-border conversion is relevant. No reviewed bundle proves a recurring country pair through exact payer, beneficiary, providers, funding, FX, token transfer, final-money receipt, scale, failure and correction.
cross_border_routes.boundary: Household demand, exchange-control context, aggregate volume or provider capability is not a verified bilateral route; the map therefore carries zero arcs.

operating_state.summary: The CNV PSAV rule is fully applicable, CNV/UIF registration and reporting are operating, and CNV's September compatibility matrix clarifies which regulated roles may be combined without relaxing the underlying requirements. BCRA's crypto-related bank and payment-provider restrictions remain on its current page. Galicia's historical bank-app crypto launch therefore is not current operating evidence; Banco Nacion's capability build and Santander's commodity-token collateral pilot remain pre-production states. MEP and Transferencias 3.0 are production fiat rails. The tokenised-securities regime is an active controlled sandbox through 31 December 2027. No current official Argentine CBDC issuance or live pilot was located.
operating_state.boundary: Effective law, registered provider, compatibility, BCRA permission, discontinued historical product, pilot, capability build, operating payment rail, controlled sandbox, authorized digital representation, transaction and public production are separate states.

scale.summary: The Ministry of Economy's 2025 fintech report reproduces a Chainalysis estimate of US$93.9 billion in value received from July 2024 through June 2025 and links use to household demand and stablecoins. No public cutoff CNV administrative aggregate was located. BCRA separately reported national 2025 payment transactions equal to 3.9 times GDP, with instant payments 64% of value and 102% of GDP.
scale.boundary: A third-party value-received estimate is not users, balances, net flows, settled FX or government administrative data; conventional fiat-payment scale is not crypto adoption.

stress.summary: The rules address potential stress through segregation, public proof of reserves, custody/key controls, immutable transaction records, annual systems audit, continuity and backup, complaint handling, suspension and cancellation. The Galicia sequence is an observed regulatory correction: the bank disclosed a 27 April 2022 launch and the BCRA imposed the sector restriction on 5 May. It does not by itself disclose customer unwind, prices, transfers, losses or final custody disposition. The reviewed official bundle does not supply a national provider-failure, stablecoin-run, custody-shortfall or customer-loss series.
stress.boundary: Required controls and risk warnings are not evidence that a firm survived stress or that customers recovered.

correction_and_loss.summary: Correction may require provider books, blockchain control, compensating transfer or issuer action, bank/payment procedures, CNV suspension, security-record reconciliation, law-enforcement seizure and court distribution. A national seizure protocol exists, while public incident-to-distribution evidence remains open.
correction_and_loss.boundary: Technical reversal, ledger correction, asset freeze, seizure, confiscation, insolvency recognition and victim restitution are separate clocks; MEP finality does not make a crypto claimant whole.

evidence_boundary.summary: The baseline uses enacted law, current compiled CNV rules, official CNV/UIF/BCRA/ARCA publications and institution-authored bank materials. An institution's own product or annual-report statement proves only what that legal person says occurred; absence from a bounded current-product search is not a guarantee of no private experiment. BBVA group services in Switzerland, Spain or Europe are not attributed to BBVA Argentina, and Santander group work outside Argentina is not treated as a local product. Frozen Currency Watch and IMF owners supply FX context without being silently updated. Register counts, CBDC claims and route arcs remain open unless primary operating evidence is found.
evidence_boundary.boundary: Fresh country research is not Chronicle promotion, investment advice, publication authority or permission to hand-edit generated projections.
